versions.changelog:
Initial release of html-to-wechat: publish existing HTML content directly to WeChat Official Account draft box.

- Supports publishing from local HTML files, URLs, or pasted HTML content.
- Automatically checks HTML for WeChat compatibility issues (e.g., unsupported styles or tags).
- Performs automated conversion to inline styles and resolves incompatibilities using the anything-to-wechat skill.
- Guides users through credential setup and all prerequisites.
- Publishes validated HTML as a draft to the WeChat Official Account draft box.
